branches.conclusion: The current central doctorate inventory offers participation in NISys and cooperative doctorates; it names no independent business doctorate, Operations programme, or Management Science specialization. Cooperative doctorates are formally awarded by their individual partner universities, so they do not establish a TH Aschaffenburg degree route.

The complete current NISys overview describes one Dr.-Ing. route, awarded by TH Würzburg-Schweinfurt, across mobility, energy/infrastructure and production/materials. These are research application fields, not formally titled Industrial Engineering or Operations doctoral programmes. Current central doctorate overview lists no other in-house degree pathway; cooperative awards belong to partners.
